title: CNDY Buys JUCE to Sweeten the Deal
story: CNDY has decided to buy JUCE, making both companies stronger together. This means they can make even better candies and drinks for everyone.
storyBig: CNDY's acquisition of JUCE is a strategic move to consolidate their market position and leverage synergies in production and distribution. The merger is currently pending regulatory approval but promises increased consumer satisfaction.
think: Why might combining two companies make them stronger?
bull: With CNDY and JUCE together, they can create new and exciting products.
bear: Sometimes merging can be tricky if the two companies don't work well together.

rss: No more cereal at the end of the aisle? New rules in Scotland's supermarkets
title: New Aisle Rules for CRNC Cereal
story: CRNC cereal can't be at the end of the aisle anymore because of new health rules. This means kids might find it in a different place in the store.
storyBig: New regulations are changing the placement of CRNC cereal in stores to encourage healthier eating habits. Products with high sugar content like CRNC may no longer be displayed at the aisle ends to decrease impulse buying.
think: How might moving where a product is in a store affect sales?
bull: This change could inspire healthier choices for shoppers.
bear: CRNC cereal may be harder to find, which could affect its sales.
